Over a hundred warships.|[[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] and [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]]|<ref name="Obsession 4">[[Obsession 4|''Obsession'' 4]]</ref>}}
The '''Boz Pity system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Halla sector/Legends|Halla sector]], within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained [[Planet/Legends|planets]] such as [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]] and [[Mourn]].
